parameters.name: Async
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to use an asynchronous link to submit job files.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The content of the job file. The content is encoded in Base64.

parameters.name: RunasUser
parameters.description:
The user to which the job file belongs.

You can call the [ListUsers](~~188572~~) operation to query the users of the cluster.

parameters.name: TargetFile
parameters.description: The name of the job file.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc create-job-file --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --runas-user testuser1 --runas-user-password '!QAZ0000' --content c2xlZXAgMzA= --target-file lammps.pbs --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc CreateJobFile --region cn-hangzhou --TargetFile 'lammps.pbs' --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-jeJki60000' --Content 'c2xlZXAgMzA=' --Async false --RunasUserPassword '!QAZ0000' --RunasUser testuser1
